Katy Clark, Baroness Clark of Kilwinning (born 3 July 1967), [ 1 ] is a British politician and life peer who has served as a Member of the Scottish Parliament (MSP) for the West Scotland region since the 2021 Scottish Parliament election . A member of the Labour Party , she was previously the Member of Parliament (MP) for North Ayrshire and Arran from 2005 to 2015 .
